title: introduce new game, with taller weather message
body: Introduce test data, sufficient to drive issue #863

issues.title: Can't view top of very tall message formats (needs scroll)
issues.body:
It's possible to create a message format that is taller than the space available.

A scroll-bar ensures all fields can be accessed. But, it can be impossible to scroll to the top of the message editor (necessary to collapse the panel).

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/123135310-8d1b2680-d449-11eb-8b7e-02fb54f3970b.png)

If the window can't be made any taller (due to being on low res laptop), the only option is to shrink the panel, so the collapse arrow becomes visible:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/123135576-dff4de00-d449-11eb-8ce7-9c536777ff24.png)

Steps to reproduce issue:
* open Serge
* enter game titled `tall msg`
* login as Game Control
* start to enter a new message
